prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 360, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 361, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 362, 'component': 'Network Proxy', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 363, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 364, 'component': 'Global Load Balancer', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 365, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 366, 'component': 'Mobile Push Token Manager', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 367, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 368, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 369, 'component': 'Data Freshness Monitor', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 370, 'component': 'Log Aggregator', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 371, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 372, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 373, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 374, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}]

response: {"incidents": [{"i": 360, "summary": "The global SSO Broker went down for 60 minutes, blocking authentication flows for all users."}, {"i": 361, "summary": "Central Message Queue experienced a major outage lasting 30 minutes, halting asynchronous processing."}, {"i": 362, "summary": "Network Proxy in US-West failed, causing a 2-hour disruption to inbound/outbound traffic."}, {"i": 363, "summary": "Critical failure of the Shared SSO Broker (30 min) brought down global identity federation."}, {"i": 364, "summary": "The Global Load Balancer dropped traffic for 30 minutes, degrading availability across all regions."}, {"i": 365, "summary": "OAuth Authorization Server in US-East was critical for an hour, preventing token issuance."}, {"i": 366, "summary": "Mobile Push Token Manager outage in LATAM lasted 3 hours, silencing notifications for users."}, {"i": 367, "summary": "The EU-West Job Scheduler experienced a critical failure for 30 minutes, delaying batch processes."}, {"i": 368, "summary": "Global Social Login Connector went offline for 60 minutes, breaking third-party auth."}, {"i": 369, "summary": "Data Freshness Monitor in EU-West was critical for 3 hours, leading to potential stale data delivery."}, {"i": 370, "summary": "Log Aggregator in ANZ suffered a 3-hour major outage, impacting observability."}, {"i": 371, "summary": "The global Job Scheduler failed for 60 minutes, pausing scheduled tasks."}, {"i": 372, "summary": "Shared SSO Broker in ME was critical for 30 minutes, blocking enterprise logins."}, {"i": 373, "summary": "Central Message Queue in US-East had a 2-hour critical outage, stalling async workflows."}, {"i": 374, "summary": "SSO Broker in US-East went down for 120 minutes, affecting regional authentication."}]}
